title: app-shell: the console's Create View dialog writes a chart view as `chart: { chartType, xAxisField, yAxisFields }`, which `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0's strict list chart config refuses by name (it requires `dataset` and `values`)
body:
Filing gate: **class (b)**, a producer writing a shape the contract refuses. `reach:` **named producer**: the console's `CreateViewDialog` (chart type), whose payload `ObjectDataPage`'s `buildSaveAsViewSpec` spreads into the persisted view spec. Reader: triage grades and routes it.

Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2`, seat post objectui#5560). It comes from the out-of-scope finding in the objectui#11572 dev report, and was re-read by this seat at objectui `origin/main` `8d0ca91` and in the npm `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 tarball. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/CreateViewDialog.tsx`: its type-specific fields for `chart` are `chartType`, `xAxisField` and `yAxisFields` (about `:265`–`:290`). Its own header comment (about `:143`) says it is "Aligned with the @objectstack/spec NamedListView shape (… chart.chartType + xAxisField + yAxisFields)".
- `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 (`src/ui/view.zod.ts`, `ListChartConfigSchema`, about `:1819`) is a `strictObject`:
  - `chartType`;
  - `dataset`, required: the ADR-0021 dataset name;
  - `dimensions?`;
  - `values`, required, `min(1)`: the measure names.
  - It has no `xAxisField` or `yAxisFields`.
- **Measured by the objectui#11572 dev:** `ListViewSchema.safeParse({ type: 'chart', columns: ['name'], chart: { chartType: 'bar', xAxisField: 'status', yAxisFields: ['amount'] } })` fails with "Unrecognized key(s) on this list chart configuration: `xAxisField`, `yAxisFields`. Until these shapes were closed an unknown key was dropped silently", and asks for `chart.dataset` and `chart.values`. The save door itself was NOT exercised.
- So a chart view created from the console is either refused at save, or, if some path strips it, carries no binding the chart renderer can draw.

## Seam
`spec:ListViewSchema.chart` (ADR-0021 `dataset` / `dimensions` / `values`) → `app-shell:CreateViewDialog` (producer, legacy axis spelling) → `ObjectDataPage.buildSaveAsViewSpec` → the view write door.

## Likely landing (a lead, not a ruling)
- The dialog authors the spec's ADR-0021 chart binding (a dataset and its measures) instead of the legacy axis fields, as objectui#7823 aligned the object page's relay with the same shape.
- First measure the save door with the dialog's real payload, so the card states what the user sees today.
- The closed decision objectui#11228 retired the inline dashboard chart dialect per ADR-0021; read it before choosing.

## Dedupe
- MCP semantic search, repo-scoped: "CreateViewDialog chart view xAxisField yAxisFields dataset values refused save" returned objectui#11228 (a dashboard dialect decision, closed), #7823 (the object-view chart relay, closed) and others about dashboards. None is about this dialog.
- Dedupe words: `CreateViewDialog chart xAxisField refused` · `create chart view legacy axes dataset` · `chart view save unrecognized keys` · `console chart view yAxisFields spec`.
